_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 14, WHAT MAKES YOU HAPPY. Individual video: the Indian couple in the Old City market (clips from Levi video, video-4955, 180s Meta-glasses POV). He says his wife; she says someone who is always with you. Shape: his best line cold ("Only she is with me, so I am happy") -> Tal: "Maybe your wife makes you happy?" "Yes" -> "I asked your husband and he said you" (she laughs, hand on heart) -> her answer ("Someone who loves, who is always with you. That makes me happy.") -> "This is a beautiful marriage" on her smile and his grin. Short on purpose (16s): the rest of the 3 minutes is either Tal explaining or lines too quiet to hear. NO ZOOMS: constant framing per shot.
_notes: AUDIO CAVEAT: she speaks softly 2m from a glasses mic in a market - her line measures 5-12 dB over the floor raw, ~15-20 dB after deep-filter. It is in a beat of its own so the per-beat gain can lift it. Her other good line ("it makes me more happy inside my soul", 120-124s) is ~3 dB over the floor and NOT used. Captions come from a hand-timed segment file (cache/translate/2e897b8f...json) because the cached Groq segments are rounded to whole seconds. The word before "only she is with me" is disputed between models (nothing/not) and is cut out.
